sql: with r as (select x.scenario_key, x.scenario_title, x.status, x.checks from public.ai_sim_results x join public.ai_sim_runs u on u.id = x.run_id where u.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and x.status in ('passed','failed')), f as (select r.scenario_key, c->>'id' as check_id from r, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(r.checks, '[]'::jsonb)) c where c->>'ok' = 'false') select r.scenario_key, max(r.scenario_title) as titulo, count(*) as rodadas, count(*) filter (where r.status = 'failed') as falhou, (select string_agg(check_id || ' x' || n, ', ' order by n desc) from (select check_id, count(*) n from f where f.scenario_key = r.scenario_key group by check_id) z) as regras from r group by r.scenario_key order by falhou desc, rodadas desc
